full_details: At Paul's Churchyard you paid sixpence for Brooke's Romeus and Juliet, worn, wanting the last leaf but one. John Harrison was in the yard and did not speak. In the afternoon the book was open at the first couplet and the notes were not written yet. At half past seven you headed a page Verona. You copied two couplets, listed names and struck two, drew two houses and a street, and left the time blank where the days would go. You set down a torch brought into a vault. You wrote that it is not yet, that the King comes first, and that this wants heat. The foot of the page is the book at sixpence. Gib lay across the right-hand page. You did not write a speech, a scene, or a line of a play.
one_sentence: You bought a worn Brooke at Paul's for sixpence, lacking the last leaf but one, and at night you made a page of notes on Verona.
title: Bought Brooke and made notes on Verona
